subject.title: Fix ACP image forwarding and Synology invalid-token throttling

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's Synology invalid-token threshold change and ACP URL-only remote-fetch reachability as shipped behavior?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically correct, but repository policy treats changed auth/throttle semantics and newly reachable guarded remote fetches as compatibility/security-boundary merge risk.

options.title: Accept Boundaries And Refresh Checks
options.body: Accept both behavior boundaries, rerun exact merge-ref validation against current main, and land if the refreshed checks remain green.

options.title: Require Stronger Live Proof
options.body: Ask for live ACP and Synology environment proof before merge if terminal runtime probes are not enough for these boundary changes.

options.title: Split The Fixes
options.body: Request separate PRs if one behavior change is acceptable now but the other needs owner or security review first.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundaries And Refresh Checks
recommendation.body: Accept both behavior boundaries, rerun exact merge-ref validation against current main, and land if the refreshed checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans ACP/media runtime and security-boundary policy; steipete has the strongest recent history across the ACP/media path and shared media fetch surface.
